'''Dalia''' was a small village on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dalicron-4]]. It was the only settlement on Dalicron-4 and had the planet's only landing facility, a large field that could house up to eight light [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]]. It was small, with a population of about 100 people. The village had various facilities, including a [[Daz's Tavern|tavern]], a [[The Mill|lumber mill]], a [[The Store|general store]] and a [[The Welcome Center|welcome center]]. The [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] doctor [[Aloor]] had an [[Doc Aloor|office]] there, while the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Meebo]] operated a hunting business from a [[Meebo's|building]] in the northwest side of the township.<ref name="COL">"[[Child of Light]]"</ref>

Dalia was founded about 800 years before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], by a group of colonists from the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. They wanted to escape their hectic lives within the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and named the settlement after [[Dalia (colonist)|Dalia]], their leader. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] agents traveled to Dalia to find [[Caeleb]], the "Child of Light."<ref name="COL" />
